title: Real-time example
summary: Imagine an AI research agent. The user asks: Research the top 10 competitors and compare their products. The agent performs: 1. Search the internet. 2. Retrieve 20 documents. 3. sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Imagine an AI research agent.

The user asks:

> Research the top 10 competitors and compare their products.

The agent performs:

1. Search the internet.
2. Retrieve 20 documents.
3. Summarize each document.
4. Call another research tool.
5. Pass all results to an analysis agent.
6. Ask the final agent to create a report.

The problem?

Every step keeps adding information to the context.

Eventually, the final agent cannot process the entire accumulated input.

(Failure)  The final report generation fails or becomes incomplete.

quiz.question: What is the most production-ready mindset for "Real-time example"?
options: Trust fluent model output without checks
Define detect → mitigate → validate loops around the concept
Only optimize prompts and ignore systems design
quiz.explanation: Production GenAI systems need explicit detection, mitigation, and validation around every critical concept.
